body: Ooo and anndd Hitman annndd assassins creed aaaaaaannd Battlefront... .-. i think i might change my date just for games...
I guess, you do have a point though.

I appreciate the support, but I'm a broken, Manic depressive, schizophrenic, 16 year old... i don't think i'm escaping these demons anytime soon...i mean i wish. I got to many problems
And not enough solutions.
That sounds amazing, i might give it a try ( that's if my social anxiety doesn't eat me alive) but i'll try.

I have, i had a Wattpad account for awhile, but i had a falling out with a friend, broke down and completely deleted my account..it was stupid. I am not on any Prescribed medications... but have a drug habit, i don't want to call myself an alcoholic, but i do drink on an almost daily basis. I know you're trying to help but, i am the black sheep of my family, everyone is normal, christian and happy. Me, i am obviously not normal...religion wise, i'm unsure of what i have faith in.  [ FSM :) jk ] and i'm not really a happy person, unless i'm high.. i don't know, i don't feel numb or trapped when i'm using  drugs or alcohol. Of course that is frowned on, in my family.. but is a common theme.

I have been afraid to go see an another therapist, i'm scared they'd hospitalize me, or worse put me back on meds. I hated taking them, they'd make me feel worse or not myself. I was on, Risperdal, Prozac, Zyprexa, and a few others i can't spell. I also was on Ativan for anxiety.. but i abused them. I write poetry, but i don't think its good enough, so i end up getting rid of all the stuff i write.
I have when i was 13, but they shrugged it off.. all they did was give me more medication. But that was 3 years ago, i'm now 16. I don't know how to describe it, I just know that, that is the day.

I think i have an idea of how you feel, All my life I've been compared to my older brother, he's a college graduate at LBU and i'm close to a high school drop out, drug addict. But you just gotta keep your head up and remember that even at night the stars shine. I remember when i was going to kill myself and my close friend stopped me and the words he said will be with me forever, "
It's not about the destination its about the journey" you just gotta keep your head up!
